title: Success ladder
subject: English Language
source: Seeded from english-language/y10 lesson 39 (Success ladder (pupil PDF))
intro: Lesson 39: Methods compared: timed comparative paragraphs and unit check. To understand how to compare views and methods in short, timed paragraphs, and where to improve next

questions.q: Unit check (10 questions in the portal).
questions.model: Teacher answers question 1: 'What is a viewpoint?' A writer's opinion on an issue.

questions.q: Core (timed, 2 x 7 minutes): in the portal response box, write two comparative paragraphs: (1) views of the sea; (2) one method each. Starter: 'Both writers...'
questions.a: Two integrated paragraphs with evidence from both texts.
questions.model: Paragraph 2 model: 'Text A's inclusive "we" draws the reader into shared guilt, whereas Text B's private "I am persuaded" expresses calm personal certainty.'

questions.q: Independent study plan: choose one of across centuries, synthesis or redrafting.
